name: Lead Gen Agent
description: Complete B2B lead generation pipeline: searches Apollo.io / Google Maps for prospects, scores against your ICP, enriches emails via Hunter, writes to HubSpot / Google Sheets / Notion / Excel, and sends personalised outreach via Gmail — with HITL email review and OAuth flows. Fully multi-tenant.

skills.name: Lead Search
skills.description: Search for B2B prospects matching role, industry, geography and company size. Auto-detects local (Google Maps) vs global (Apollo.io) mode. Returns ICP-scored and ranked leads.
examples: Find 10 fintech CTOs in the US
Find VP Engineering leads at SaaS companies with 50-200 employees
Find marketing agencies in Lahore Pakistan

skills.name: Lead Enrichment
skills.description: Enrich existing contacts with verified email addresses via Hunter.io.
examples: Find the email for John Smith at Stripe
Enrich this contact list with verified emails

skills.name: CRM Write
skills.description: Write qualified leads to HubSpot, Google Sheets, Notion, or Microsoft Excel. Deduplicates by email. Tenant selects CRM via /crm/select.
examples: Save qualified prospects to our Google Sheet
Sync leads to Notion after scoring

skills.name: Email Outreach with Review
skills.description: Compose personalised cold-outreach emails and send via the tenant's Gmail. Pauses for HITL review before sending. Triggers Gmail OAuth if not connected.
examples: Send personalised outreach emails to qualified leads
Compose and review email drafts for 10 CTOs before sending
Draft personalised emails for each qualified lead and show me before sending

skills.name: Full B2B Lead Gen Pipeline
skills.description: Complete pipeline: search → ICP scoring → email enrichment → CRM write → personalised Gmail outreach with user review. One call does everything end-to-end.
examples: Find me 10 fintech CTOs to contact this week and add them to HubSpot
Build a prospect list of SaaS VPs in the US, save to CRM and send outreach emails
Run a full lead gen campaign for Series B fintech companies in London
Find 5 CTOs in Europe, score them, add to HubSpot, draft outreach
